content: Ukɔɔn atsüül baar bumwɛy nsaŋ
« Twon an'tsul nsaŋ, waa ngye sye mpa batsüül nsaŋ.
Ntɔn ngye sye bàsatsüül asànaa afàtsüül ngye baar bumwɛy, ngye sye bàsasi unsà isii afàsi ngye baar bumwɛy.
Ntɔn nkye amanà ngye nà un'lɛŋ awà u dii a un'tɔŋ angye, wɛɛ umpaaŋ a làbää wà u dii angye, ngye wa amanà anki?
Aben, ngye akwen mutɛn a un'tɔŋ angye naa: "Wɛy mɛ alwom un'lɛŋ u dii a ngye", wɛɛ le, ngye awe anà umpaaŋ a làbää u dii angye?
Ngye mbuur a mpem yweel, tàlwom umpaaŋ a làbää wà u dii angye, waa ngye ayàtääl ubwaŋàbwaŋ ntɔn mulwom un'lɛŋ u dii a un'tɔŋ angye. »
« Twon an'pà undiir a in'kyɛɛl akà mbwà. Twon lan'piy an'yak abɛ màntal kusà a ngul, manà ya iyàndyàndyäär ma anà ya iyàbulà mper akà bɛ ntɔn mukàlakyer ube. »
Lɔm, leŋ, bɛɛrà kà ibeenà
« Làlɔ̈m waa bàsàlapà, làleŋ waa bɛ làsàman, làbɛɛrà waa bàsàladuub.
Ntɔn mbuur awalɔm akyer awal, mbuur aleŋà akyer aman, akà mbuur awà abɛɛrà bàkyer asun'duub.
Nà uboo abɛ kan'kwo mupà nkɔŋ akà mwan ande, isàkal naa nde kan'lɔm mampà?
Naa sye nde kun'pɛ idyà an'kwar isàkal naa nde kan'lɔm nsö?
Bɛ, abe a baar làbà bɛ, isàkal naa bɛ làyöb mupà indiir aŋàbwaŋ akà baan abɛ, nkye ikɔɔn akà Taaràbɛ awà u du mupà indiir aŋàbwaŋ akà baar bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m bya! »
« Abun, ndaa yanswà làkwen bɛ naa baar bàlakyeer, bɛ ŋakwo làkyer ya ntɔn ba: wawà un'kɔɔn anà aŋangɔɔm. »
Munàmbwo ikikye
« Làbilà u munàmbwo ikikye! Munàmbwo a kölàköl anà mbwo aŋàyaam ifàbiil baar kukwà, baar mbɔɔn bàfàbilà kwo.
Wɛɛ munàmbwo a ikikye anà mbwo a inküünà ifàsyen baar u mɔ̈ɔ̈, baar mbɔɔn ya bàfàman anki. »
Aŋangɔɔm a loor
« Wɛy bɛ làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn aŋangɔɔm a loor. Ba bàfàbulà asànaa in'kɔk mpal bàfàyà ba akà bɛ, wɛɛ uboo a mpem aba, ba bà an'kyɛŋbɔl a mpɔr.
Bɛ, bɛ ba làsayöb unsà nkääl aba. Nkye ban'kwo bàbwe rɛzɛ unsà bite a nsyeenà, itàkal an'figɛ unsà ikwarngyal?
Kyakin, un'te aŋàbwaŋ afàbɔr mbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ un'te un'be afàbɔr mbɛŋ ambe.
Un'te aŋàbwaŋ ukwe anki mubɔr mbɛŋ ambe, itàkal isɔ̈ɔ̈là a un'te mubɔr mbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ.
Un'te wanswà mpa afàbɔr mbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ bàkyer afàtsul wa, waa bàfàtɔɔm u mbaa.
Abun, bɛ aŋangɔɔm a loor làsayöb u mbɛŋ aba. »
Alɔŋki a ndandaa
« Kyakin, kà baar banswà anki bàfàtɛn a mɛ naa "Mwol, Mwol", bàsàbilà uboo a Imwol a du, wɛɛ ba mpɛl bàfàkyer ukwen a Taaràmɛ awà u du.
Kà ilä kya, baar mbɔɔn bàsàtɛn a mɛ naa: "Mwol, Mwol, nkye ngye ayöb anki naa bi kàtɛɛ ngɔɔm kà ikɔb angye, bi kàböŋ insɔŋà kà ikɔb angye, bi sye kàkyer impà mbɔɔn kà ikɔb angye?"
Abun mɛ in'safuur naa: "Mɛ alàyöb anki akà ikikye, làkyà kunà, bɛ baar làfàkyer ube!" »
Ndwà yweel
« Undiir awun, mbuur wanswà kan'wem ndaa an'tɛn mɛ yi anà ukasyäälà ya, asàkal asànaa ŋun'yɛnà mwɛy kàtöŋ ndwà ande udu a nkɔŋ.
Mpal kànɔ̈ mbul, ngyäl yàsi an'swɛb, ikül a mbul kyàsiinà ndwà ayi, wɛɛ ya yàbü anki ntɔn in'bään aya myàkäl udu a nkɔŋ.
Wɛɛ mbuur wanswà kan'wem ndaa an'tɛn mɛ yi anà ukɔɔn asyäälà ya, asàkal asànaa insil mwɛy kàtöŋ ndwà ande udu a ansɛŋ.
Mpal kànɔ̈ mbul, ngyäl yàsi an'swɛb, ikül a mbul kyàsiinà kya ndwà ayi, laa yàbü ya: mbwabà aya yàkäl yàngwal. »
Ikɔ̈b a Yɛsu
Apan, mpal kàmay Yɛsu nswɛɛŋ ayi, baar banswà bàkäl mubem ntɔn an'lɔɔŋ ande,
ntɔn nde ba kalɔɔŋà a ikɔ̈b kyanswà, wɛɛ kà asànaa alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn aba anki.
